original_defects: Cancelled appointment history blocked staff/service archival
A future active booking could be archived and disappear from the default list while still reserving time
before_fix: Two focused regressions failed: resource archival threw active-resource error; active-booking archive missed expected rejection.
policy: Active booked interval is future/ongoing until its computed end including buffer, according to server clock. New archival forbidden until cancellation or elapsed interval. Cancelled/elapsed history may retain archived resources without altering start/end/status. Old archived future bookings retained and still checked for conflicts.

covered: future active booking and resources reject archival without state/revision/audit change
elapsed booked history can archive without invented cancellation or attendance
file restart and validated restore preserve records and computed end
archived resources cannot be used to revive/new-book a future active interval
legacy archived future booking remains readable and reserves its interval without blocking unrelated updates
original buffer overlap and adjacent-interval scenario remains tested

browser.reload: Show archive reveals past interval with original booked status and11:15+05 end; cancelled future interval visible

limits: No attendance claim from elapsed time
No calendar synchronization, payments, notifications or new public hosting
Domain validation/error wording only; UI shell and DB schema unchanged; not a whole-surface/security audit
